items.quote: Thus saith the LORD, About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt:
items.claim: The LORD will go out into the midst of Egypt around midnight

items.quote: And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the first born of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne, even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that is behind the mill; and all the firstborn of beasts.
items.claim: All the firstborn in Egypt will die, from Pharaoh's firstborn to servants' to beasts
